id: \rSo my question is why do you never see someone walk sideways?
en: \rSo my question is why do you never see someone walk sideways?
it: \rLa mia domanda è: perché non si vede mai nessuno camminare di lato?

id: \rHow am I supposed to train if I lose?
en: \rHow am I supposed to train if I lose?

id: \rSerena: \PN! Are you looking for the Pokémon Village too?
en: \rSerena: \PN! Are you looking for the Pokémon Village too?
it: \rSerena: \PN! Anche tu stai cercando il Villaggio Pokémon?

id: \rI don't think we will be able to find it. It's hidden very well. Let's have a battle instead.
en: \rI don't think we will be able to find it. It's hidden very well. Let's have a battle instead.
it: \rNon credo che riusciremo a trovarlo. È nascosto molto bene. Facciamo una lotta, piuttosto.

id: \rI have to say \PN, I appreciate all the time we have had together. You've taught me so much about friendship, passion, and always moving forward.
en: \rI have to say \PN, I appreciate all the time we have had together. You've taught me so much about friendship, passion, and always moving forward.
it: \rDevo dirtelo, \PN, ho apprezzato tutto il tempo che abbiamo passato insieme. Mi hai insegnato tanto sull'amicizia, sulla passione e sull'andare sempre avanti.

id: \rAnd no matter how hard things get you never give up. Plus there is always time to stop and appreciate the simple things going on around you.
en: \rAnd no matter how hard things get you never give up. Plus there is always time to stop and appreciate the simple things going on around you.
it: \rE per quanto le cose si facciano difficili, tu non ti arrendi mai. In più c'è sempre tempo per fermarsi ad apprezzare le cose semplici che ci circondano.

id: \rIn short, thank you.\nOh wait, you still have a gym battle to finish, don't you!? Don't wait around. Head back and finish it.
en: \rIn short, thank you.\nOh wait, you still have a gym battle to finish, don't you!? Don't wait around. Head back and finish it.
it: \rInsomma, grazie.\nAh, aspetta, devi ancora finire una lotta in Palestra, vero!? Non perdere tempo. Torna indietro e finiscila.
\rSerena: Vai a finire la tua lotta in Palestra, \PN.

id: \rI think I'll just be on my way.
en: \rI think I'll just be on my way.
it: \rCredo che me ne andrò per la mia strada.

id: \rYou'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle us.
en: \rYou'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle us.
it: \rTi servono almeno due Pokémon se vuoi sfidarci.
\rHo catturato i miei Pokémon insieme a Nana.

id: \bI'm not worthy to be in your immediate space.
en: \bI'm not worthy to be in your immediate space.
it: \bNon sono degno di stare nel tuo spazio vitale.
